notes.title: Update v0.3.2
notes.content:
Hey there Chaos Makers. So the game is out and we are working full time for fixes. So I want to thank everyone for giving us and the game a chance. Here are the first notes for our updates:

- Drone mechanics will get expensive every time you buy one.

Fixes:

- Drone and Card Modifiers on the shop will now be truly closed ( Keep looking for the future updates)

- Fixed a few Turkish translation issue in How To Play.
